child_stream_contract.traversal: Predecrement descriptor+0x34 pointer by2; signed16 zero terminates. Nonzero signed16 is displacement/radius operand inEAX. Predecrement by2 again for encoded axis/radius inEBX; repeat backwards.
child_stream_contract.axis: (encoded_word&6):0 first matrix row,2 second,4 third; bit0 negates each signed32 element before SAR16 and multiply. Axis6 is not present in these three original lists.
child_stream_contract.radius: EBX=(encoded_word&0xfff8)<<15 modulo32; if23-descriptor_scale is nonzero, SAR by x86-masked count. EAX displacements are applied to the original caller relative vector for every child.
child_stream_contract.f1533_bounds: Signed16 descriptor+2C/+30 scaled by descriptor+14+18-8 using F1495; bounds are source units, not inferred SI radii.
child_stream_contract.natural_resources: Reuse exact immutable ground117..133 and fuel134..148 descriptors, firstfour source vertices and complete natural collision programs. No modern planet radii substituted.
child_stream_contract.model117: Original nonspherical layout retained. Caller-specific correction and DOS/JJFFE instruction variants require separate evidence; no spherical conversion or generic caller equivalence.
limits: No damage/landing/docking policy or full live original object bank.
